newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Russia says Najibullah execution "odious massacre".
newsitem.headline: Russia says Najibullah execution "odious massacre".

text.p: Russian Foreign Minister Yevgeny Primakov said on Monday the killing of former Afghan president Najibullah by the Islamist Taleban movement was an "odious massacre".
"The odious massacre of Najibullah was not a glorious page in U.N. activities," Primakov said in a comment on the hanging last week of the former president by Taleban rebels who took power in Kabul.

"The U.N. were not responsible for the killing of Najibullah...But gave him a guarantee for his safety four years ago...It was one of conditions of his retreat from power," Primakov told reporters after a 24-hour visit in Morocco.
Primakov made his comments shortly before leaving Morocco where on Sunday he had met King Hassan.

Najibullah led a Moscow-backed government in Afghanistan for six years and was ousted on April 16, 1992, by Moslem Mujahedeen, who refused to let him leave the country and join his family in India. He sought refuge behind the walls of U.N. headquarters in Kabul, an unwilling recluse.
Taleban executed Najibullah, his brother and two other aides on Friday immediately after capturing Kabul from the ousted government of President Burhanuddin Rabbani.
Asked about the possibility of establishing diplomatic ties between Russia and the new Kabul government, Primakov replied:
"This issue was not examined by Moscow."
